headline: Mexican peso depreciates after inflation rebound in Mexico
summary: The peso depreciated as Mexican inflation picked up and global risk aversion rose on tech-sector losses and renewed tariff threats from Donald Trump.
why: The peso is a key emerging-market currency, and Mexico's exchange rate and inflation shape Banxico's policy and foreign investor flows. Tariff threats from the US, Mexico's largest trade partner, affect its export outlook.
why_moved: Inflation picking up and renewed US tariff threats raised risk aversion, while losses in the tech sector drove a broader pullback from riskier assets.
original_headline: Peso mexicano se deprecia tras repunte de inflación en México
